newsitem.title: USA: Trinity says verdict goes against company.
newsitem.headline: Trinity says verdict goes against company.

text.p: The United States District Court for the Southern District of New York on Monday returned a verdict by jury against Trinity Industries Inc and CIGNA, in the retrial of an action brought against Trinity by Morse/Diesel Inc in 1984, a statement from Trinity said.

The statement said a verdict was rendered in favor of Morse/Diesel in the amount of $31 million, plus interest from July 18, 1984. The statement said a verdict was also rendered in favor of Trinity on its counterclaim of $6 million plus interest from December 18, 1984.

Trinity said it will pursue all avenues in the post-trial and appellate review processes. While Trinity's ultimate liability in this matter is difficult to assess, the company said it believes the final outcome is not likely to have a material adverse effect on its financial position.
CIGNA spokeswoman Dina Baker said she was unaware of the verdict. CIGNA acted as the bonding company for Trinity on the subcontract that initiated the suit, Trinity said.
